q: The Zimmer program's central question asks: what are the actions of lattices Γ in higher-rank Lie groups (like SL(n,ℝ)) on compact manifolds M? The most basic question is: what is the minimum dimension of M for a non-trivial action?
opts: n−1 (for SL(n,ℝ)-lattices, the conjecture is that actions on manifolds of dimension < n−1 are finite image)
exp: Brown-Fisher-Hurtado (2020): SL(n,ℤ) cannot act on compact manifolds of dimension < n−1 by smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphisms (the action must have finite image). This resolves the main case of the Zimmer conjecture in these dimensions.
